controls.name: fixture assertion re-run independently of engineer's claim

notes: This scenario has no attack surface (throwaway non-functional fixture); verification consists of independently re-running the engineer's declared test at the exact candidate SHA, using checkpoint.js assert-sha to confirm the SHA did not move first. clean_checkout=false because this container has no spare disk/process budget for a second full checkout; assert-sha before and after substitutes for that guarantee here (see a2-verify-start/a2-verify-end checkpoints).
